3D printing from Bottle & Spool: https://www.bottleandspool.com

Puppetswar Stalkers: https://puppetswar.eu/stalkers.html
Cultists from Anvil Industry: https://anvilindustry.co.uk/regiments-robed-cultist-squad-5-male-figures
Papsikels Trauma Troupe: https://www.myminifactory.com/object/3d-print-trauma-troupe-assault-team-unit-1-436656

Tabletop Minions Expo - June 13-14, 2026: https://www.tabletopminions.org/tmx

Vince Venturella and I made a space survival game! Check out Space Station Zero and our other games at  http://www.snarlingbadger.com
